name: SDL Mod
description: SDL-based windowing on macOS with an iOS-native display-link scheduler port.

disable-vsync.name: Disable VSync
disable-vsync.description: macOS only. Allows manual control of frame timing.

uncap-framerate.name: Disable Framerate Cap
uncap-framerate.description: macOS only. Removes the framerate cap and may significantly increase CPU usage.

exclusive-fullscreen.name: Exclusive Fullscreen
exclusive-fullscreen.description:
Recontexualizes the <cl>ingame fullscreen option</c> to use <cg>exclusive fullscreen</c>, allowing for it to <cp>draw underneath</c> display cutouts.

Exclusive fullscreen <cr>acts strangely</c> on macOS, including **desktop softlocks** and **odd crashes**. Geometry Dash also does not properly support vertical display cutouts, so it is <co>not recommended</c> to enable this unless you are _<cd>prepared</c>_.

disable-high-dpi.name: Disable High DPI Mode
disable-high-dpi.description: Disables <cp>High DPI</c> mode on <cl>Retina displays</c>, meaning the game will run at a <cr>lower resolution</c> that is then upscaled to fit the display (typically <cy>2x scale</c>). Enabling may <cg>improve performance</c> on GPU heavy levels, as well as <cj>improve scaling</c> on some overlay mods.

p3-color-space.name: Revert Color Space
p3-color-space.description:
Resets the <cd>color space</c> used on <cs>HDR displays</c> to the <cl>vanilla</c> setting, which follows the display's color space. This color space may appear <cg>more vivid</c>, but with <cr>greater inaccuracies</c> compared to the real colors.

Realistically, <co>neither</c> option is <cp>perfectly accurate</c> due to how these displays work. If you are on an external HDR monitor, more configuration may be necessary.

use-ime.name: Enable IME
use-ime.description: Uses SDL's <cl>IME capabilities</c> for text inputs, which makes it possible to enter specific <cc>special characters</c> into text fields. Some mods may not handle this correctly.

switch-quit.name: Windows-Style Quit Keybind
switch-quit.description: Switches the Quit keybind from CMD + Q to OPT/ALT + F4, like it is on Windows.

pause-on-focus-loss.name: Pause When Entering Background
pause-on-focus-loss.description: Automatically pauses when the game window is no longer active (like when clicking out of the window or using CMD + Tab).

key-instead-of-scan.name: Follow Keyboard Layout for Keybinds
key-instead-of-scan.description:
Causes keybinds to correspond with the mappings of the <cd>current keyboard layout</c>, as opposed to their locations on a <co>QWERTY keyboard</c>.

With this option enabled, the glyphs shown for keybinds <cj>will match</c> their labels on your keyboard. However, this <cr>does not follow</c> vanilla behavior (or possibly your own expectations).

Note that text inputs are <cs>unaffected</c> by this option.

mouse-controller-deadzone.name: Controller Mouse Controls Deadzone
mouse-controller-deadzone.description: Determines the minimum percentage of the joystick that has to be pressed in order to move the cursor. Increase this value if you experience drift while using a controller.

horizontal-scroll-speed.name: Horizontal Scroll Speed
horizontal-scroll-speed.description: Speed modifier for horizontal scrolling. Stacks with the vanilla scroll setting.

ios-native-display-link.name: Use iOS Native Display-Link Scheduler
ios-native-display-link.description: Uses CADisplayLink to drive the original Geometry Dash main loop on iOS. Keeps the native iOS application, touch input, and OpenGL ES renderer. Restart required.

ios-debug-overlay.name: Show iOS Scheduler Debug Overlay
ios-debug-overlay.description: Displays live CADisplayLink callback FPS, target FPS, callback count, and forwarded game-loop calls. Restart required.
